fact.claim: An RDS DB subnet group requires a subnet in at least two Availability Zones, which also makes it easy to switch to a Multi-AZ deployment later.
fact.question: How many Availability Zones must an RDS DB subnet group cover?

values.display: a subnet in at least two Availability Zones
